high_level_description: The image shows a person holding a book titled "Creative Art" with a cover featuring a giraffe's head and a zebra's head, both painted on hands. The background of the cover is green with colorful floral designs. Below the title, there is a quote that reads, "Design is not a thing you do, it's a way of." The person is wearing a maroon garment with a patterned design. In front of the book, there is an open sketchbook with a pencil drawing of a bird's head. The drawing appears to be a simple sketch with some shading. There are signatures on the sketchbook page
